text:
Predicates:
American(x) ::: x is an American national.
ProfessionalBasketballPlayer(x) ::: x is a professional basketball player.
JumpShot(x) ::: x can do jump shots.
Leap(x) ::: x leaps straight into the air.
Activate(x, y) ::: x activates y.
LegMuscles(y) ::: y are leg muscles.
Premises:
∃x (ProfessionalBasketballPlayer(x) ∧ ¬American(x)) ::: Some professional basketball players are not American nationals.
∀x (ProfessionalBasketballPlayer(x) → JumpShot(x)) ::: All professional basketball players can do jump shots.
∀x (JumpShot(x) → Leap(x)) ::: If someone can do jump shots, they leap straight into the air.
∀x (Leap(x) → Activate(x, legMuscles)) ::: If someone leaps straight into the air, they activate their leg muscles.
¬Activate(yuri, legMuscles) ::: Yuri does not activate his leg muscles.
Conclusion:
American(yuri) ∧ ProfessionalBasketballPlayer(yuri) ::: Yuri is an American professional basketball player.
